cost.basis: Neither enchantedhillsnapa.org nor lighthouse-sf.org publishes rental, lodging, meal or day-use rates; all stays, meetings, weddings and packages go through an inquiry form ('prices listed are subject to change and do not include taxes'). No third-party listing (Retreat Finder, Hipcamp, napavalley.com) shows a price either.
cost.source_label: Enchanted Hills Napa - Events inquiry form
cost.hint: Terms page only reveals the payment structure: 25% deposit with signed contract, +25% at 90 days, +25% at 30 days, final count and balance 14 days before the retreat; taxes and extras additional.

availability_notes: Off-season rental venue (groups of ~30-150; Forest Commons hall up to 200) owned by LightHouse for the Blind; summer camp for blind/low-vision campers runs mid-June to early August (2026 sessions end Aug 8) with a Fall Family Camp Oct 30-Nov 1, so the nine target weekends all fall in the rental season. Lodging is camp-style (Hillside casitas, Lakeside cabins, lodge dorm rooms, safari tents, yurts) with many shared rooms and bathrooms. Booking is 'subject to availability and confirmation'; inquire via web form or events@lighthouse-sf.org / (707) 261-1101. No public availability calendar.
